title: Winning Post 2
overview:
Feel the thrill of being an owner! The long-awaited sequel to the hugely popular horse racing simulation. Now with race commentary for an even greater sense of presence!

The setting is the horse racing world of the near future. With 200 million yen in starting funds, you become a racehorse owner. What ending awaits at the end of your 30-year term...? Savor the joy of being an owner to the fullest in this game that vividly recreates the real world of horse racing.

- Thrilling commentary makes race scenes even more exciting! You can also choose between two ways to watch races: owner's box mode and digest mode.
- Enjoy as many as 2,500 races at 16 racecourses, including overseas expeditions and local tracks. And of course, you can buy betting tickets too.
- Interaction with as many as 500 people surrounding thoroughbreds, race tactics, a variety of events... an emotional experience just like an RPG!
- Even horse racing beginners can play smoothly with advice from your secretary and the "Horse Racing Glossary."
- In the richly varied versus races, passwords from other platforms can also be used.
- 30 BGM tracks, including 22 composed by Yukihide Takekawa. New arrangements raise the quality even further.

馬主の感動を実感！超人気・競馬SLG待望の続編。
レース実況も入って、さらに臨場感がアップ！

舞台は近未来の競馬界。与えられた2億円の資金を元にあなたは馬主となります。30年の任期の果てに待つエンディングは……？ 実際の競馬界を鮮やかに再現したこのゲームで、馬主の喜びを存分に味わってください。

●手に汗握る実況でレースシーンはさらに迫力満点！しかもレース観戦は馬主席観戦モードとダイジェストモードの2種類から選択できる。
●海外遠征、地方も含め、16の競馬場で2500ものレースが楽しめる。もちろん馬券購入も。
●サラブレッドを巡る500人もの人々との交流、レースの駆け引き、様々なイベント……まるでRPGのような感動体験！
●競馬初心者の方も、秘書のアドバイスと“競馬用語事典”でスムーズにプレイできる。
●バリエーション豊富な対戦レースでは、他機種のパスワードも使用可能。
●タケカワユキヒデ作曲の22曲を含むBGMは30曲。ニューアレンジでクオリティもさらにアップ。
